question: How do document counting, exact-byte deduplication and declared-lineage grouping count independent synthetic origins, including wrong or missing lineage?
scope: Synthetic accounting and failure-mode demonstration only; no inferred real-world independence, production adapter, JH16 change or scientific approval.

templates: An observation of synthetic signal {token} was recorded.

methods.document_count: Each document is a distinct support group.
methods.exact_hash: Group by SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 text bytes; no semantic inference or text normalization.
methods.declared_lineage: Group by observed_lineage when present. Each missing lineage is its own document group; never group all null values together. This method cannot access truth_origin.

truth: Generator-assigned independent origins are synthetic labels, not measured independence. Truth is used only by evaluation. Equal text does not imply equal origin.

metrics.support_groups: Number of groups reported by a method.
metrics.signed_count_error: support_groups minus number of generator origins; negative means net undercount.
metrics.double_count_excess: Sum over truth origins of max(0, number of reported groups containing that origin minus 1).
metrics.collapse_excess: Sum over reported groups of max(0, number of distinct truth origins in that group minus 1). This is excess collapsed memberships, not a count of wholly lost documents.
metrics.merged_independent_pairs: Number of distinct unordered truth-origin pairs placed in any one reported group.
metrics.cost: Deterministic documents visited, UTF-8 bytes hashed and number of retained group keys; execution wall/CPU time measured separately, not treated as scalable benchmarks.

aggregation: Retain all per-seed/scenario/method values; report mean and min/max per scenario/method. No significance tests, optimized threshold, seed dropping or rankings pooled across scenarios.
expectations_and_falsifiers: Exact-hash deduplication removes exact copies but misses paraphrases and collapses independent identical text; report both error directions separately.
Declared lineage is exact when supplied with exact generator truth. This is an oracle-assisted contract control, not evidence that lineage can be discovered.
Missing or false-split lineage can overcount; false-merged lineage can undercount. A failure to expose either direction fails this pilot's acceptance.
The identity signed_count_error == double_count_excess - collapse_excess must hold for every result.
acceptance: Generate and retain every stated seed/scenario with raw document text, truth_origin and observed_lineage.
Replay generates byte-identical datasets, results and aggregate summary without network or third-party packages.
Independently check fixtures for identical independent texts and paraphrased shared origin, missing metadata, false merges and false splits.
Retain any failed run log and explain implementation repairs without editing this frozen protocol.
environment_contract: CPython 3.12 standard library; deterministic core JSON excludes timestamps and measured durations. Capture interpreter/platform and hashes in a separate receipt.
chronology_limit: Locally recorded protocol-before-run chronology with hash and file creation; no claim of independent timestamp attestation or external preregistration.
